messages:
Noah S.: FYI customer reported repeated mid-stream disconnects when switching between Wi‑Fi and cellular on iOS 16/17. Happens around ~30–120s into a streaming response. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/3721
Noah S.: They see partial output then the SSE connection drops. Logs show a client-side reset and server reports 499/connection closed by client.
Maya (Mobile): I can repro on a Pixel too. Quick repro steps I used locally:
```
1) Start a streaming EventSource to our /v1/streams endpoint
2) Wait for ~20s of tokens
3) Toggle Wifi OFF -> Cellular ON (or enable airplane mode then re-enable)
4) Observe `onerror` then `onopen` sometimes, but stream doesn't resume tokens.
```
Maya (Mobile): Mobile HTTP libs close sockets aggressively when network changes. Our client doesn't attach a resume token; we just reconnect from scratch so the user sees missing tokens.
Sam F.: Can you paste the EventSource init you used? Also which backend headers are sent?
Maya (Mobile): Sure — JS test harness: 
```js
const es = new EventSource('/v1/streams?prompt=hello', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <key>' } });
es.onmessage = e => console.log('msg', e.data);
es.onerror = e => console.log('err', e);
```
Maya (Mobile): No resume param. On native Android I used OkHttp with `newWebSocket` which also just drops.
Elaine (SRE): From infra side: LB logs show TCP FIN from client at ~30s after network change, no 5xx on server side. Backend saw partial chunks and then the connection closed. No application exception.
infra-oncall: Confirming — health checks normal; no spikes in CPU. We see a flurry of short-lived connections during the customer's timeframe.
devops-bot: Deployed a short-lived patch to emitter keepalive interval (15s -> 10s) to test if NAT timeouts are the issue. deploy#web-keepalive-2026-03-02
Noah S.: Suggested customer-facing reply draft: "We're seeing client-side TCP closes when the device changes networks. Two mitigations: (1) implement client reconnect with resume token so stream continues, (2) increase client socket keepalive/heartbeat and apply exponential reconnect with jitter." Thoughts?
Sam F.: Add note to recommend SSE comment heartbeats too — server can emit `: keep-alive\n\n` comment line every 15s so some mobile NATs/key routers don't kill the connection. Also recommend `Connection: keep-alive` and smaller TCP keepalive on mobile if configurable.
Maya (Mobile): For resume flow we can attach a `x-redwood-resume-token` header on every chunk from server. If client reconnects with that token we can replay from last sent token. That needs server support and a short token TTL. I can prototype on iOS/Android.
Elaine (SRE): Server-side: we currently don't persist per-stream transcript beyond short-lived in-memory buffers. Replay requires storing stream checkpoints (offset+cursor) for N seconds (configurable). If you want, we can store checkpoints for 2 minutes to cover common mobile handoffs. Ops impact: small mem cost per active stream.
Noah S.: Action items: 1) Maya prototype client resume (due EOD) 2) Elaine evaluate checkpoint window & infra cost (ETA 2 days) 3) Sam add docs snippet + support reply template.
Sam F.: Support reply template: "Sorry about the interruption — this is likely caused by the device dropping the TCP connection when switching networks. Can you try updating to the latest mobile client that retries the stream and provide a packet capture (pcap) or app logs if the issue persists? In the meantime, we can enable short-term server keepalives for your account to reduce NAT timeouts."
Noah S.: I'll send the template to the customer and ask for app version + network carrier + sample request id.
Maya (Mobile): Quick note — on iOS there's an NSURLSession quirk: background network handoffs sometimes deliver `NSURLErrorNetworkConnectionLost`. We should classify that as recoverable and attempt resume.
Elaine (SRE): Infra note: LB idle timeout is 60s. If connections drop at ~30–120s, it's likely client side. We'll test with 15s heartbeat from server and report back.
infra-oncall: Ran a sim with forced network toggle — saw client FIN then immediate reconnect, but without resume token we always restart from prompt.
Noah S.: OK. I'll update the ticket with our plan and ETA. If we get more customers hitting this we may fast-track a resume-token feature.
Maya (Mobile): I'll post a small reproducible repo link in the thread once cleaned up.
Sam F.: Also adding a short blurb for docs about "best practices for streaming on mobile" (keepalive, backoff, resume token).
Elaine (SRE): Closing loop here once we see deploy metrics after keepalive tweak.
Noah S.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
